headline: 生化危机爆发夜领跑，不是你的恋爱首播
summary: 本周电影《生化危机：爆发夜》等热作领跑，《不是你的恋爱》首播；热播剧《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》持续吸睛，待映片单含《复仇者联盟5》《猫鼬》。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作《生化危机：爆发夜》本周领跑。
industryHighlights.en: Film hit Resident Evil: Outbreak Night tops this week's buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧《不是你的恋爱》本周首播。
industryHighlights.en: New series Not Your Love premieres this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》等持续在榜。
industryHighlights.en: The Rookie, Rick and Morty, and House of the Dragon remain in the hot series lineup.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影《复仇者联盟5》《猫鼬》《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films Avengers 5, Mongoose, and Xian Ni theatrical edition draw attention.

headlineEn: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night leads; Not Your Love premieres
summaryEn: This week, Resident Evil: Outbreak Night leads film buzz, while new drama Not Your Love premieres; hits The Rookie, Rick and Morty, and House of the Dragon stay strong, with Avengers 5 and Mongoose upcoming.
